raw_description:
Make expenses easier to organize and categorize by adding relevant tags when you create or edit expenses in the web application. Add one or more custom tags to capture business, project, event, or other dimensional context beyond standard expense fields.

Benefits
• Add one or more custom tags while creating or editing an expense.
• Capture relevant business, project, event, or other dimensional context with expense records.
• Organize and categorize expenses beyond standard expense fields.
title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add tags for expenses as submitter
